metadata.title: Zefiro Net S.r.l. — Shared Mobile Infrastructure
metadata.description: Zefiro Net SRL is the 50/50 joint venture between Iliad Italia and WINDTRE dedicated to the sustainable deployment of 5G and 4G mobile networks across Italy's rural areas.

nav.governanceNotice: Section upcoming: Corporate governance documentation and annual reports will be published soon.

footer.tagline: Connecting in a breath. The 50/50 joint venture between Iliad Italia and WINDTRE for wholesale mobile connectivity across rural areas.

hero.sottotitolo: We accelerate the rollout of 5G and ultra-broadband networks across Italy's less densely populated areas. Through RAN sharing, we foster sustainable wholesale infrastructure, minimizing environmental impact while ensuring digital inclusion for all.

missione.sottotitolo: Technological excellence and sustainability empowering communities

manifesto.sottotitolo: The foundational principles and core value charter steering every strategic, technical, and human choice at Zefiro Net.

homepage.chiSiamoSottotitolo: Bridging the digital divide by delivering 5G and ultra-broadband networks across 70% of national territory, focusing on rural and sparsely populated areas home to approximately 26.8% of Italy's population. With around 7,000 active mobile sites and towers, we operate an open, efficient, and sustainable wholesale infrastructure.

tecnologia.sottotitolo: Cutting-edge radio access solutions to connect the country while reducing environmental footprint and optimizing capital investment.
tecnologia.ranSharingDesc: Radio Access Network (RAN) Sharing is a technological framework where operators share radio access infrastructure (antennas, base stations, power supplies, and transmission backhaul) while maintaining strictly autonomous and separated Core Networks and subscriber services.
tecnologia.percheRanSharing: Why Zefiro Net Adopts RAN Sharing
tecnologia.motivo1Desc: Sharing radio access enables partners WINDTRE and Iliad to eliminate duplicate infrastructure costs, power consumption, and maintenance in lower-density regions.
tecnologia.motivo2Desc: Avoiding parallel tower rollouts significantly reduces landscape footprint, overall electromagnetic impact, and power consumption, driving decarbonization.
tecnologia.motivo3Desc: A unified network allows next-generation 5G speeds and capacity to reach rural communities and mountain areas far quicker than isolated single deployments.
tecnologia.motivo4Desc: Centralized Network Operations monitor sites and key performance indicators (KPIs) around the clock to ensure maximum reliability and rapid response.
tecnologia.coperturaDesc: Zefiro Net technically manages physical mobile infrastructure covering approximately 70% of Italian national territory, serving rural and low-density regions where approximately 26.8% of the population resides across ~7,000 active sites.
